no_project_selected: Select a project to get started
no_projects: Add a project folder to get started
remove_project_confirm: Remove {title} from hoshi? Its threads are deleted. The folder on disk is not touched.
thread_titles_generate_description: A small model names each new thread from its first message, and again once the agent answers if the subject was unclear. Off, the first line names it
thread_titles_model_description: Runs once per thread, with no tools; a quick model is enough
thread_titles_instructions_description: Added to how titles are written, such as the language or the style
worktree_setup_description: A command run in each new worktree of {project}, such as installing its dependencies. It runs in its own terminal, with HOSHI_PROJECT_ROOT and HOSHI_WORKTREE_PATH set.
worktree_setup_wait: Wait for it before the agent starts
worktree_setup_wait_hint: Messages wait until the command succeeds. If it fails, you choose whether to send them anyway.
compaction_chip_compact_hint: This thread's cache ran out: the next send compacts its {tokens} tokens into a summary first, so it doesn't reread them all. Click to keep the full history.
compaction_chip_keep_hint: The next send keeps all {tokens} tokens of history. Click to compact first.
browser_empty_hint: Type an address above, or ask the agent to open one.
terminal_exited: Process exited. Press any key to restart.
terminal_exited_with_code: Process exited with code {code}. Press any key to restart.
diff_unavailable: No diff to show for this file
forge_error_unauthorized: You're not signed in to this forge. Check Settings → Source control.
forge_error_rate_limited: The forge is limiting requests. Try again in a minute.
forge_error_unreachable: Couldn't reach the forge. Check your connection.
forge_error_unavailable: This pull request isn't available right now.
merge_blocked_permission: You can't merge this pull request
merge_blocked_draft: Mark it ready for review before merging
git_blocked_detached: Detached HEAD: check out a branch first.
git_blocked_clean: Worktree is clean. Make changes before committing.
git_blocked_uncommitted: Commit or stash local changes before pushing.
git_blocked_behind: Branch is behind upstream. Pull first.
git_blocked_diverged: Branch has diverged from upstream. Rebase or merge first.
git_blocked_up_to_date: Branch is up to date. No action needed.
git_error_commit_message: Couldn't write a commit message. Use Commit… to write one.
git_error_push_behind: The remote has commits this branch doesn't have. Pull or rebase, then push again.
git_error_no_base_branch: There is no base branch to open the pull request on.
git_error_forge_unauthorized: Sign in to the forge in Settings to open pull requests.
git_error_forge_unavailable: This project's repository isn't on a connected forge.
git_error_busy: Stop the agent before running git actions.
git_default_branch_description: This pushes straight to "{branch}". You can continue on this branch or move the changes to a new branch and run the same action there.
git_commit_description: Review and confirm your commit. Leave the message blank to auto-generate one.
pr_watching_tooltip: Watching: the agent wakes when checks finish, someone comments, or the branch conflicts
secret_request_note: Saved to a file only the agent's commands read. It never goes to the chat.
edit_from_here_description: Rewind chat to before this message. Your prompt and attachments return to the composer. “Revert files too” also undoes your own edits.
rewind_failed_detail: The conversation couldn't go back to this message.
rewind_no_checkpoint: No copy of the files was kept from before this message, so they can't be put back. Try again keeping the changes.
rewind_busy: Stop the agent before going back.
rewind_folder_busy: Another thread is working in this folder. Wait for it to finish, or go back keeping the changes.
diff_not_a_repository: This thread's folder is not a git repository
diff_truncated: The diff is too long; only its start is shown
no_pull_request: This branch has no pull request
pr_load_failed: Couldn't load the pull request's checks and comments
address_comments_prompt:
Address the unresolved review comments on pull request #{number}. Fix what each one asks for, then summarize what you changed.

{comments}
github_description: Pull requests of your threads' branches, read with the GitHub CLI's account
forge_signed_out: Not signed in. Run gh auth login in a terminal.
composer_placeholder: Ask anything… @ files, / commands, # pull requests, $ skills
composer_suggestions_pull_requests_unava: Pull requests aren't available for this project
composer_suggestions_no_skills: No skills found. Your own, project and plugin skills show here
composer_command_model: Choose the model for this thread
composer_command_default: Leave plan mode and make changes
theme_description: Follow the system or always use light or dark
use_theme_both: Use for both light and dark
remove_theme_description: You can bring it back anytime by importing its JSON file.
remove_themes_description: Select the variants you want to remove. You can restore them by importing the extension again.
use_first_variants: Use the first variants for light and dark
theme_file_drop_hint: Drop hoshi or VS Code .json files
theme_file_too_large: That file is {size}. Theme files are only a few KB, so this one was not read (limit {limit}).
theme_file_unreadable: Couldn’t read that file. Paste the JSON below instead.
search_community_themes_description: Find open-source themes from Open VSX.
community_theme_description: A community color theme for your editor.
update_theme_description: This replaces its installed variants, including any local edits. Variants no longer in the extension will be removed.
open_vsx_search_unavailable: Open VSX search is unavailable right now.
open_vsx_unreadable: Open VSX returned an unreadable response.
open_vsx_details_unavailable: Open VSX theme details are unavailable right now.
open_vsx_no_manifest: That Open VSX extension has no readable manifest.
open_vsx_no_themes: That extension does not contain compatible color themes.
open_vsx_too_many_themes: That extension contains too many color themes to import safely.
open_vsx_download_failed: That Open VSX theme could not be downloaded.
open_vsx_no_checksum: That Open VSX theme has no readable checksum.
open_vsx_integrity_failed: That Open VSX theme failed its integrity check.
open_vsx_unsafe_package: That extension package is not safe to open.
open_vsx_package_mismatch: That extension package does not match the selected Open VSX theme.
open_vsx_theme_unreadable: One or more color themes in that extension could not be imported safely.
theme_error_collection_changed: Your installed themes changed while this package was downloading. Try again.
theme_error_vscode_no_background: That VS Code theme has no "editor.background" color, so there is nothing to build a palette from.
theme_error_invalid_json: That theme file is not valid JSON.
theme_lacks_light: “{name}” has no light palette. Create a theme with the same name to add one.
theme_lacks_dark: “{name}” has no dark palette. Create a theme with the same name to add one.
theme_error_not_an_object: Theme files must contain a JSON object.
theme_error_unsupported_version: This theme file uses an unsupported version. Expected 1.
theme_error_missing_appearance: Theme files need an appearance of "light" or "dark".
theme_error_missing_colors: Theme files need a colors object.
theme_error_invalid_id: Theme ids may only contain lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens.
theme_error_unknown_role: "{role}" is not a supported theme color.
theme_error_invalid_color: The color for "{role}" must be a literal CSS color such as oklch(0.62 0.2 280).
theme_error_no_colors: Add at least one color to the theme file.
theme_error_invalid_variants: Theme variants may only be named "light" or "dark".
theme_error_variant_repeats_appearance: Theme variants must not repeat the base appearance "{appearance}".
theme_error_already_installed: A theme named "{name}" is already installed.
theme_error_light_palette_taken: “{name}” already has a light palette. Pick another name.
theme_error_dark_palette_taken: “{name}” already has a dark palette. Pick another name.
theme_error_palettes_taken: “{name}” already has light and dark palettes. Pick another name.
prompt_font_description: Only the box you write prompts in. Mono works well here.
monospace_font_description: Code blocks, diffs, file previews and the terminal.
terminal_font_description: Terminal output, independent from code blocks and diffs.
word_wrap_description: Wrap long lines in code blocks, diffs and file previews by default.
separate_fonts_description: Set the prompt, code and terminal fonts separately instead of one monospace font.
font_smoothing_description: Use thinner grayscale text smoothing instead of the macOS default.
prompt_preview_fix: to fix the flaky test in
interface_font_description: Everything outside code blocks and the terminal.
code_font_description: Code blocks, diffs and file previews.
lighter_text_description: Thinner medium and bold weights, which Linux draws heavier
claude_code_enabled_description: Allow threads to run with Claude Code
claude_code_binary_path_description: Leave empty to find claude on your PATH
turn_failed_provider_disabled: Claude Code is turned off. Turn it on in Settings → Providers.
turn_failed_spawn: Couldn't start Claude Code. Check that it is installed, or set its path in Settings → Providers.
turn_failed_process_exited: Claude Code stopped before finishing this turn.
turn_failed_provider_error: Claude Code reported an error and stopped this turn.
access_accept_edits_description: Edits apply on their own; asks before anything else your Claude Code settings don't allow
access_auto_description: Claude Code judges what is safe to run
access_full_description: Runs anything without asking, except what your Claude Code rules ask about
plan_mode_setting_description: Show a Plan toggle in the composer: the agent reads and proposes a plan without changing anything
plan_mode_description: Reads and proposes a plan without changing anything
no_favorite_models: Star a model to keep it here
error_not_a_git_repository: This project isn't a git repository, so it can't use a worktree.
context_compacts_automatically: Compacts automatically as it nears the limit.
context_window_size_pending: The window size is known after the first reply.
usage_pace_mark: The line is where even spending would be.
usage_unavailable_description: Check that the provider is installed and signed in, then try again.
usage_no_limits: This plan has no usage limits
usage_no_limits_description: API keys and some plans have no session or weekly windows.
provider_version_description: The installed CLI, checked against its latest release every few hours.
provider_update_unchanged: The updater finished, but the CLI still reports an older version.
provider_update_turns_running: Wait for running turns to finish, then try again.
provider_update_unsupported: hoshi can't update this installation. Update it the way you installed it.
provider_update_timed_out: The updater ran for 30 minutes and was stopped.
app_update_restarts: hoshi restarts to finish the update.
app_update_failed: The update couldn't be installed. Try again later.
bitbucket_description: Pull requests of your threads' branches on bitbucket.org, read with an Atlassian API token kept in the system's credential store
bitbucket_token_help: Create an API token with scopes for Bitbucket and give it these scopes.
bitbucket_error_credentials: Bitbucket didn't accept that email and token. Check them and the token's scopes.
cleanup_offer: Pull request #{number} was merged. Remove its worktree and the local branch {branch}?
cleanup_offer_root: Pull request #{number} was merged. Switch the project folder back to {base} and delete the local branch {branch}?
cleanup_local_only: Only this machine changes; the branch on the forge stays.
cleanup_error_dirty: Its folder has uncommitted or untracked files. Commit or discard them first.
cleanup_error_not_merged: Its pull request isn't merged yet.
cleanup_error_unpushed: The branch has commits that exist only on this machine. Push them first, or remove only the worktree folder.
cleanup_error_nothing: There is no worktree or branch left to remove.
cleanup_error_adopted: This worktree was already there before the thread moved into it, so hoshi leaves it as it is.
worktree_released_hint: Worktree folder removed; the next message brings it back
cleanup_merged_confirm: Remove the worktrees and local branches of {count} merged threads? Project folders on a merged branch go back to its base branch. Threads with uncommitted files or commits only on this machine are kept. Nothing on the forge changes.
cleanup_error_locked: The worktree is locked. Unlock it with git worktree unlock first.
cleanup_error_locked_reason: The worktree is locked ({reason}). Unlock it with git worktree unlock first.
startup_view_description: What the app shows when it opens.
inactive_after_description: Idle threads untouched this long move to Inactive.
notifications_setting_description: Notify when a thread finishes, fails or needs your input while hoshi is in the background.
palette_pull_request_placeholder: Search pull requests by number, title or branch
pull_requests_need_forge: Connect GitHub or Bitbucket in Settings to see pull requests.
pull_request_thread_failed: Couldn't check out the pull request's branch: {detail}

error_project_name_invalid: A project name needs at least one character and none of / \ : * ? " < > |
error_git_url_invalid: That doesn't look like a Git URL.

summary_worktree_released: Worktree, released to free the disk
access_ask_description: Asks before edits and anything else your Claude Code settings don't allow
